text_block_list.text:
As I walk around the shopping district, I
spot
Мэдзиро МакКуин in front of a
fishmonger's stall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All of this fish... So this is what a real
fishmonger
is like...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And enshrined at the very center, a sea

pineapple! It does look rather shocking...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: It spoke!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Trainer! Please don't startle
me like
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I came to explore the market a little bit.
I never
had the opportunity to come as a
child.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And, well... I heard there was something
here
called a sea pineapple...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
They're low in fat and packed with
nutrients.
Perfect for my die—I mean,
they're quite healthy
so I was interested
to give one a try.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: It certainly looks unusual... Think you can eat it?

text_block_list.text:
Well, I admit my confidence is waning... I
didn't
realize how... mushy it would be.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I don't know that it would agree with my

stomach... But if it's for my d—for my
health...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Should I brace myself
like I'm
about to run down the slopes of
Yodo and eat it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Let's take a look at something else.

text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right... I'm sure there are plenty
of other
wonderful things here apart
from sea pineapples.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What's that one with the sharp,
painful-looking
spikes?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A sea urchin... I didn't realize their
exterior was
like that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: What about this? It has... thirteen legs?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: D-dare I?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No, you're right. No matter how strange
this food
may seem, faltering here would
make me a
laughingstock for the rest of
my life.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I won't bring shame upon the great
Mejiro name!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Now, let's give it a taste!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hm? It doesn't taste quite as horrifying
as it
looks. There's a subtle delicacy to
it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I feel empowered! Not to mention, it's
good for
my diet.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You've helped me discover something
new about
myself. Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. Why don't you take this
opportunity
to try it for yourself? Come
now, there's nothing
to be afraid of.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин urges me to try the
strange
delicacy with a boastful look. It
seems even sea
pineapples are no match
for a Mejiro.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a crisis averted, Мэдзиро МакКуин
acquires
valuable knowledge about all
kinds of sea
creatures.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
